directAnswer: To check a smart display, ensure it is powered on and connected to Wi-Fi, then use the device's settings menu to verify its status and functionality.
summary: This guide provides steps to check the status and functionality of your smart display, including troubleshooting tips for common issues.

sections.heading: Initial Checks
sections.body: Before diving into settings, confirm that your smart display is plugged in, powered on, and connected to your home Wi-Fi network.

sections.heading: Navigating Settings
sections.body: Access the settings menu on your smart display to review connectivity and display settings. The navigation may vary by brand.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting Common Issues
sections.body: If the display is not functioning properly, consider restarting the device or checking for software updates through the settings menu.

steps.title: Power On the Device
steps.detail: Ensure your smart display is plugged in and press the power button to turn it on.

steps.title: Check Wi-Fi Connection
steps.detail: Go to the settings menu and select 'Network' to confirm that your device is connected to Wi-Fi.

steps.title: Review Display Settings
steps.detail: In the settings menu, check 'Display' options to adjust brightness and other visual settings.

steps.title: Update Software
steps.detail: Look for a 'Software Update' option in the settings to ensure your device is running the latest version.

faqs.question: What should I do if my smart display won't connect to Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Try restarting your router and the smart display. If the issue persists, check for any network outages or consult the manufacturer's support.

faqs.question: How can I reset my smart display?
faqs.answer: Most smart displays have a reset option in the settings menu. Alternatively, you can perform a factory reset by holding down the power button for a specific duration, which may vary by model.

faqs.question: Can I use my smart display without Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Some features may be available offline, but most functionalities, including streaming and updates, require a Wi-Fi connection.

caveats: Menu paths and options may vary by brand and model of smart display.
